g.title: C1
g.text: PTFE; 2 wires per pole, 3 A each derated (SQSO-HAR-001 5.2), above the 5 A pack fuse

g.title: C2
g.text: two 10 kOhm NTCs, common return to VBAT- in the pack (TBR)

g.title: C3
g.text: sense only; fuse or 100 Ohm series at the pack end (TBR)

g.title: J2
g.text: EPS board, to BMS VC0-VC4 via 1 kOhm + 0.1 uF filters (TBR)
